as_told.title: Marc Andreessen told whole areas of physics were classified in the Cold War

plain: Two technology investors, Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, are said to have been told by a staff member of the National Security Council, the White House body that advises the president on security, that parts of physics had been made secret. Jesse Michels, a podcast host, and the researcher Matthew Pines both repeat it, and Pines, calling it hearsay, says the staffer told them whole areas of basic physics had been classified before and that the same could not be done for artificial intelligence. Pippa Malmgren, speaking on Michels' show, links it to many technologies from the nuclear age being hidden away, and she also credits the researcher Eric Weinstein. Weinstein himself says the two were told not to invest in artificial intelligence startups because those would not be allowed to exist. They raise it because, if true, the government has a history of quietly locking away entire branches of science.
